title: Make Junie a first-class PromptHub field
resolution: Made the Junie orchestrator a first-class PromptHub field. Type chosen: `junie: Junie` held by value (mirrors the by-value non-Arc subsystems like sanitizer/auth/lineage; Junie holds only a cheap owned AgentIdentity so no Arc is needed), initialized via `Junie::new()` in PromptHub::new(), placed right after the `hooks` field. Added `#[derive(Debug, Clone)]` to the `Junie` struct (additive) so PromptHub's `#[derive(Debug)]` still holds. Exposed `pub fn junie(&self) -> &Junie` accessor in the 'Accessors for server layer' section next to storage()/metrics(). Existing JunieHook wiring is untouched: `hub.hooks.register(Box::new(JunieHook))` still runs in new(), so hook-based orchestration is unchanged while the orchestrator is now reachable directly. NO-DOWNGRADE: nothing removed/stubbed; only additive field + accessor + derives. Tests: added hub::tests::test_hub_exposes_junie_accessor (verifies accessor returns a usable handle with name=Junie, role=Junie, Execute capability, stable identity across calls); existing junie::tests::test_junie_identity and hooks::tests junie tests still pass. Gates (both configs, all green): `cargo build -p prompt-hub` (default), `cargo test -p prompt-hub --all-features junie` (4 passed), `cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean), `cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean), `cargo fmt -p prompt-hub -- --check` (clean), `cargo build --workspace --all-features` (CLI + server compile).
objective: JunieHook only reachable via hooks module; no direct hub field, no dedicated CLI wiring beyond commands/junie.rs. Add Junie as a first-class PromptHub field with accessors.
acceptance_criteria: PromptHub exposes a Junie accessor; CLI wiring consistent
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
